div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Start: customer asks for a date

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Find or create customer
(CustomerService: duplicate check
on normalized phone / email / National ID)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Duplicate
found?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Block creation / show possible matches
for staff review (no auto-merge)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Create quotation
(QuotationService.create_quotation:
hall, event type, package, guests,
services, start / end)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Calculate itemised price
(PricingService.calculate:
hall + package + pricing rules
+ services + extra guests - discount)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Availability check
(AvailabilityService:
hall active, hours, special hours,
maintenance, conflicts, buffer)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Show reason (conflict / hours /
maintenance / closure) and
offer another hall or time

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Send quotation to customer
(status draft -> sent, valid_until set)
NOTE: quotation reserves NOTHING (BR-08)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Customer
accepts before
valid_until?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Quotation expires
(status expired)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: End: no booking

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Accept quotation
(QuotationService.accept_quotation)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Re-check availability
immediately before insert
(BEGIN IMMEDIATE, BR-09)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reject conversion:
BookingConflictError
(friendly message, no booking created)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: End: offer another slot

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Guest count within
hall capacity (BR-06)
and duration at least
package minimum (BR-07)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reject: ValidationError
(over-capacity / too short)
no booking created

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Create Pending booking
(BookingService.create_booking:
freeze price snapshot + policy
snapshot, hold_expires_at = now + 48h)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Hold reserves the hall exclusively
(BR-03). Notify Manager / Receptionist
(new_booking, hold_expiring)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Wait for deposit payment
(recorded by staff: cash / bank /
card / InstaPay — no gateway)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Deposit recorded
before hold end
+ 24h grace?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Booking Expired, hall time released
(lazy sweep: BookingService.sweep_expired_holds)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: End: customer must start again

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Paid amount reaches
30 percent deposit
threshold?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
InsufficientDepositError:
booking stays Pending,
outstanding deposit shown

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Auto-confirm booking
(BR-10, no separate approval):
status pending -> confirmed,
installment plan created,
financial policy snapshot frozen

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Generate contract
(ContractService.generate_contract:
versioned HTML from template,
unique contract number)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Generate event plan
(TaskService.generate_event_plan:
checklist copied from task templates
matching event type / package)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
End: Confirmed booking
with contract + event plan
